title: Fear recedes in humble company
summary: Let mercy steady the breath before fear writes the day. Keep this close: Hold onto this: move toward the humble until fear loses its command.
takeaway: Return the breath before fear chooses the story.
lifeApplication: Before the next defensive move, bring the breath back under one line of refuge and mercy.

source.shortMeaning: Humble company makes room for the Merciful One to settle the mind.
source.lifeApplication: When fear narrows you, move toward company that carries mercy instead of panic.
